headline: Autonomous AI breakthroughs meet advanced quantum mechanics
summary: Today's research spans a powerful self-improving AI agent breaking quantum and chip design records alongside six foundational papers exploring quantum entanglement, nonlocality, and dynamics. These works collectively showcase how algorithmic automation and theoretical quantum physics are rapidly advancing in parallel.

themes.title: Autonomous AI for Scientific Discovery
themes.body: An autonomous AI research harness successfully broke state-of-the-art records in quantum information and optimized chip energy efficiency for a fraction of traditional costs.

themes.title: Quantum Entanglement and Information Theory
themes.body: New theoretical insights derive explicit quantum logarithmic Sobolev constants, analyze epsilon-smoothed entanglement of formation via Moreau-Yosida approximations, and map tripartite nonlocality in quantum networks.

themes.title: Quantum Dynamics and Algorithmics
themes.body: Researchers explore interference-induced transport decay in disordered lattices, twist-controlled imaginary-time Mpemba effects in spin chains, and sparse Carleman embeddings for quantum algorithms.

connections.body: Both papers advance quantitative bounds and entropic contraction rates for quantum systems, bridging abstract functional analysis with concrete quantum channel properties.
